name: Portuguese date formatting is distinct from English
description: Portuguese dates should localize too (month names and time formatting follow pt conventions). On /pt the same match's kickoff text must differ from the English rendering. The test judges that the rendering localized for pt, without hard-coding the exact translated string.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and capture the first match id
Navigate to /en/match/<captured-id> and read the visible kickoff date/time text
Navigate to /pt/match/<captured-id> and read the visible kickoff date/time text for the same match

Verify the Portuguese kickoff date text is localized (Portuguese month/weekday naming or pt time format) and differs from the English rendering of the same instant. If the /pt date is byte-identical to the English date, the test fails.
